title: Bounded execution of the signed remainder step
statement: Let the machine limits be given, along with a program, a call depth, and natural numbers $M,V,fr,a$. Suppose $1\le M$, the space limit is at most the word limit, $4V+4M+16$ is at most the word limit, $fr+\bigl(\lfloor\log_2(V+1)\rfloor+2\bigr)$ is at most the space limit, and $a=|x|$ for an integer $x$. From a state whose locals are initialized by the frame $[x,M,fr,a\bmod M,0,t]$ and whose memory is any function $\mu'$, the signed remainder program has an execution of cost at most $12$ ending in a state whose local at position $0$ is the integer remainder of $x$ modulo $M$ and whose memory remains $\mu'$.
hypotheses_covered: space limit is at most word limit
